newsitem.title: USA: Universal Health to co-own GWU Hospital.
newsitem.headline: Universal Health to co-own GWU Hospital.

text.p: Universal Health Services Inc said on Thursday it signed a joint venture partnership agreement to co-own and operate Washington's George Washington University Hospital, as the hospital ended partnership negotiations with Tenet HealthCare Corp.
Universal Health said it will invest $125 million over the next 10 years in the the hospital's operations, including an immediate commitment of $80 million.
Universal Health will own 80 percent of the partnership, and George Washington University will own 20 percent.

Universal Health said the hospital ended talks with Tenet due to lack of a strategic fit between Tenet and George Washington. Universal Health shares were down 7/8 to 31-5/8 late Thursday, while Tenet was up one, to 26.
The company said a management agreement with the university for operating the hospital takes effect immediately, while the partnership must file for certificate of need approval.
Employment will be offered to the 501-bed hospital's current workers.
Universal Health is a public hospital management company, with 68 facilities nationwide.
